panels.description: Top real users by 24h RTP. RTP = sum(GAME_REWARD CASH amount) / sum(GAME_INSERT amount). Filtered to users with >= 100 coins inserted to suppress drive-by noise. RTP > 100% means the user is extracting more than they invested via the heat formula — investigate immediately.
panels.title: Top real users by 24h RTP

targets.rawSql: WITH activity AS (SELECT a.account_id, COALESCE(a.display_name, '') AS display_name, SUM(CASE WHEN al.action_type = 'GAME_INSERT' THEN al.amount ELSE 0 END) AS coins_inserted, SUM(CASE WHEN al.action_type = 'GAME_REWARD' AND al.currency = 'CASH' THEN al.amount ELSE 0 END) AS cash_earned FROM accounting_logs al JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = al.account_id WHERE al.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND al.action_type IN ('GAME_INSERT', 'GAME_REWARD') AND a.role NOT IN ('bot','admin') GROUP BY a.account_id, a.display_name) SELECT account_id, display_name, coins_inserted, cash_earned, (cash_earned / NULLIF(coins_inserted, 0) * 100)::numeric(8,2) AS rtp_pct FROM activity WHERE coins_inserted >= 100 ORDER BY rtp_pct DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20

panels.description: Count of real users with 24h RTP > 100% AND >= 100 coins inserted. Healthy = 0. Anything > 0 fires the P1 alert.
panels.title: Users above 100% RTP (24h)

targets.rawSql: WITH activity AS (SELECT a.account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN al.action_type = 'GAME_INSERT' THEN al.amount ELSE 0 END) AS coins_inserted, SUM(CASE WHEN al.action_type = 'GAME_REWARD' AND al.currency = 'CASH' THEN al.amount ELSE 0 END) AS cash_earned FROM accounting_logs al JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = al.account_id WHERE al.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND al.action_type IN ('GAME_INSERT', 'GAME_REWARD') AND a.role NOT IN ('bot','admin') GROUP BY a.account_id) SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS leaks FROM activity WHERE coins_inserted >= 100 AND cash_earned > coins_inserted

panels.description: Aggregate RTP across all real users in the last 24h. Σ rewards / Σ inserts. Healthy band: 30-70%. Above 80% means the formula is bleeding wealth out of the bot pool faster than the tuning anticipated.
panels.title: Aggregate real-player RTP (24h)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN al.action_type = 'GAME_REWARD' AND al.currency = 'CASH' THEN al.amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN al.action_type = 'GAME_INSERT' THEN al.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 0)::numeric(8,2) AS aggregate_rtp_pct FROM accounting_logs al JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = al.account_id WHERE al.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND al.action_type IN ('GAME_INSERT', 'GAME_REWARD') AND a.role NOT IN ('bot','admin')
